name: Shimonita (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shimonita town emblem in white: a stylised device of a broad bar above a ring, like a letter T.
history: Municipal flag of Shimonita, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1965.

features.role: Shimonita town emblem — a stylised device of a broad bar above a ring, like a letter T
